metadata.title: Map Signal
metadata.author: generated from an FTL event wiki
metadata.description:
Logs one line to FTL_HS.log whenever the star map is opened or closed, so a program outside the game can tell which screen the player is on. Nothing is drawn and nothing about the game changes.
Written for the save watcher in this repo, which shows an event card on a second monitor and wants to show the sector profile while the map is up.
Requires FTL Hyperspace.
